ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 90% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels to 10% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-substrate blob across 0-100% of the visible surface. High-intensity white clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral distal tips (left and right edges). Multiple thin, linear white pixel features are distributed throughout the interior lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with an obtuse interior angle of approximately 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth ratio of roughly 1:10 relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth serrations across the entire boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks ranges from 4 to 15 pixels relative to the adjacent valleys, isolated clearly from the blue water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile along the trailing edge sweeping from the notch to the tips; the leading edge (partially visible submerged) shows a broad convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) located on the distal margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional linear high-contrast disruptions (rake marks) scattered across both lobes; most prominent are diagonal streaks on the left lobe and vertical scratches near the right trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white rake marks (likely killer whale tooth marks) across the fluke surface; heavy calcified colonization on the distal margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Individual high-contrast white patch on the distal right lobe edge, proximal to the calcified cluster, distinct from the linear markings.
